description:
The sparse comparison harness in `crates/gf2-coding/examples/` (`bench_sparse_csv_emitter.rs`, `sparse_smoke_emit_expected.rs`) has no block-CSR, RCM or prefetch arms for $\mathrm{GF}(p)$ and $\mathrm{GF}(2^m)$, and no LinBox arm for $\mathrm{GF}(2^m)$ sparse elimination; those cells are classified `not-yet-harnessed` and stay out of the smoke run.

## Background

The example headers named these arms as missing; the source-comment sweep removed the statements, and this issue tracks the work.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each `not-yet-harnessed` cell has a harness arm validated for result equality against the existing arm, or is reclassified as unsupported with the reason recorded in the classification source.
- [hard] REQ-02: Timed comparisons run only in the overnight benchmark window and commit their receipts, per `@/inv/benchmark-backed-performance`.
title: Harness the not-yet-harnessed sparse comparison cells
